title: Q3 Hybrid Private/VPC/On‑Prem Capability Slicing and OKR Alignment
creator: Maya Patel
description: Purpose: Create a prioritized, testable quarter roadmap slice for Q3 that aligns Private/VPC/On‑Prem capabilities with company OKRs, reduces cross-team dependencies, and defines rollout waves for enterprise customers. Scope: features and infra work required to support hybrid deployments at scale: (1) Private control plane upgrades, (2) VPC peering and network hardening, (3) on‑prem installer/upgrade UX, (4) RBAC and audit log ingestion, (5) private telemetry and observability retention policies, and (6) rollout gating and rollback playbooks. Outcome: a sequenced plan with dependencies, owners, acceptance criteria, telemetry KPIs, and communications plan so Sales/CS can commit to customer timelines.
acceptance_criteria: Capability slices defined and prioritized with clear minimum viable deliverables for each wave
Dependency matrix validated with Eng leads and updated ticket mappings (ENG-xxxx)
OKR mapping document completed: each deliverable tied to at least one company OKR and measurable KPI
Rollout waves with gating criteria and rollback steps documented
Customer-facing timelines and CS enablement materials drafted for top 10 enterprise customers
Security review checklist completed and sign-off from InfoSec for Q3 release
decisions: Adopt two-wave rollout (Beta wave for early adopters; General wave for GA) to reduce blast radius
Prioritize VPC peering + audit logging in Wave 1 due to regulatory customers' needs
Delay non-critical console UX polish to post-GA to keep schedule for infra deliverables
risks: Kernel/runtime upgrades required by dedicated infra may slip and block VPC peering tests
Third-party KMS integration timelines uncertain and may affect security sign-off
Customer-specific network topologies require additional engineering time beyond estimate
Coordinating upgrades for private control plane across multiple on‑prem instances may require support staffing increases
telemetry_kpis: Median cold-start latency for private endpoints (target < 200ms for gen-1 models)
End-to-end deployment success rate for private upgrades (>95% in Beta)
Number of rollback events during Beta (target 0-1 per major customer)
Reduction in per-token cost variance across deployment modes (target < 15% dispersion)
